sentence_stem: No sooner had the bell rung
correct_completion: than the students rushed out of the classroom.
full_sentence: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out of the classroom.
acceptable_variants: than the students hurried out of the room.
than the students dashed from the classroom.

options.text: when the students rushed out of the classroom.
options.why_wrong: 'No sooner' is paired with 'than', not with 'when', so this completion does not follow the correlative structure.

options.text: the students rushed out of the classroom.
options.why_wrong: Without a connecting word such as 'than', the clause cannot complete the correlative 'no sooner' structure.

options.text: until the students rushed out of the classroom.
options.why_wrong: 'Until' expresses a limit in time, not the immediate sequence required by 'no sooner'.

options.text: than the students rushed out of the classroom.

grammar_focus: Correlative structure 'no sooner ... than' expressing immediate sequence
explanation: 'No sooner' is always followed by 'than' in the main clause, which expresses that the second event happened immediately after the first.
translation: ደወሉ ገና እንደተደወለ ተማሪዎቹ ከክፍሉ ሮጠው ወጡ።
